question: Should CodexBar expose both Neuralwatt prepaid USD credits and active subscription kWh allowance, or deliberately define this provider as prepaid-balance-only?
rationale: The API exposes two independently usable quota pools, and source inspection cannot determine whether displaying an exhausted prepaid balance while subscription quota remains is an acceptable product contract.

options.title: Surface both quota pools
options.body: Add a distinct subscription kWh metric when an active allowance is returned so the menu reflects all currently usable Neuralwatt capacity.

options.title: Accept balance-only semantics
options.body: Keep the current UI but explicitly document and approve that CodexBar may report exhausted prepaid credits while subscription capacity remains.

options.title: Defer the provider
options.body: Pause both Neuralwatt PRs until the mixed-unit quota presentation has an agreed product design and exact-head live proof.

recommendation.title: Surface both quota pools
recommendation.body: Add a distinct subscription kWh metric when an active allowance is returned so the menu reflects all currently usable Neuralwatt capacity.

likelyOwner.reason: The related branch history shows direct ownership of the provider hardening and the written recommendation requiring this product decision.
